text:
Type: metal cabinet on slim legs
Use: storing small items, books and supplies; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: industrial, retro, modern
Materials: powder-coated steel body, door and legs, small tab pull
Colors: bright tomato red
Shape: narrow upright box with one full-height flat door, tiny tab pull, four thin straight legs raising it off the floor, clean sharp edges, slim and light, compact
Feel: bold, playful, graphic, cheerful
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, black accents; industrial, Scandinavian or retro living rooms and home offices

product.name: LIXHULT
product.description: Helps you keep track of small items like chargers, keys and wallets, or more bulky items like handbags and toys. It all depends on which of the 3 cabinet sizes you choose.
